US Private Sector Job Growth Tops Forecasts Private businesses in the US added 90K jobs in September 2026, following a downwardly revised 36K in August and exceeding forecasts of 70K. Hiring accelerated for the first time since May, led by education and health care and leisure and hospitality. Financial activities and professional and business services showed weakness. — link

US Core PCE Price Index Falls to 3% in August, Lowest Since February The US core PCE price index rose 3% year over year in August, easing slightly from the previous month to its lowest level since February, versus market expectations of 3.3%. The monthly core PCE price index increased 0.2% in August, below expectations of 0.30%, while the previous reading was revised from 0.20% to 0.1%. — link

Bastion Trading Urges SkyAI Board Overhaul, Questions Related-Party Consulting Fees Bastion Trading is urging Solana treasury company SkyAI to overhaul its board, raising concerns over shareholder interests. According to Bastion, SkyAI paid $5 million in consulting fees in H1 2026 to a related party controlled by the brother of its director and CIO—equivalent to roughly 92% of its staking revenue. At the September 18 annual meeting, all five incumbent directors received more withheld votes than votes in favor, while approximately 82% of votes opposed the equity incentive plan. Bastion and its affiliates, which hold about 9.99% of SkyAI, are calling for meaningful engagement and new directors, and are prepared to pursue legal action if the board fails to respond. — link

CoinShares: Digital Asset Investment Products See $3.55B in Weekly Inflows, Largest This Year CoinShares’ digital asset biweekly report, published on September 29, showed that global digital asset investment products recorded approximately $3.55 billion in net inflows last week, the largest weekly inflow of the year, after flows were broadly flat over the previous two weeks. Total assets under management rose to approximately $173 billion, while year-to-date inflows reached $8.6 billion. By asset, Bitcoin products saw $2.52 billion in inflows, followed by Ethereum with $702 million, Solana with $193 million and XRP with $92.3 million. — link
